mechanism: Senna-induced diarrhea may reduce mefloquine absorption and efficacy while both agents can cause gastrointestinal distress and mefloquine may alter electrolyte balance exacerbated by senna's laxative effect.
action: Separate administration by at least 2-4 hours; monitor for reduced antimalarial efficacy and electrolyte abnormalities; consider alternative laxative if mefloquine use is essential.
